summary: Iteration 38: Login Page Removal & Creator Mode Testing - All 12 features verified and working correctly. App loads directly to Dashboard without login page. All 23 sidebar sections visible without authentication. Creator Mode button at bottom of sidebar opens password modal. Wrong password shows error, correct password (¢re@tor@AIengine) unlocks Creator Mode showing 'Kairos AI Engine' link and 'ON' badge. Creator badge appears in header. Clicking AI Engine navigates to /ai-agents. Exiting Creator Mode hides AI Engine link. Direct navigation to /ai-agents without Creator Mode redirects to /. No logout button exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 verified login page removal and Creator Mode functionality. AuthContext provides default user without login. Creator Mode validates password via /api/auth/login with email=kairoserp. AI Engine (/ai-agents) only accessible when creatorMode=true. localStorage key 'kairos_creator_token' stores creator token.
